**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

[Gentlemen](../others.html#258),[^1]
I enclose the slip you have been so good as to forward to me - with a few corrections, to which I would wish to add that I have been the author of ‘the [Kings of England](../books.html#6),’ and of ‘Landmarks of History’ [‘] [Ancient](../books.html#14)’, ‘[Middle Ages](../books.html#16)’ and ‘[Modern](../books.html#28)’ being a compendium of Universal History for young people. I should prefer no statement being made as to the application of the proceeds of my publications

your obt servt

C M Yonge

[^1]: The biographical dictionary referred to here was probably Men of the Time (7th ed.

London: Routledge 1868), whose entry on CMY appears to correspond with this letter.
